Package neqsim.process.equipment.subsea

Class UmbilicalFluid

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.subsea.UmbilicalFluid
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class UmbilicalFluid extends Object implements Serializable
Liquid carried in an umbilical hydraulic or chemical injection line.

Holds density, temperature-dependent dynamic viscosity (Andrade form mu(T) = mu_ref * exp(B * (1/T - 1/T_ref))) and isothermal bulk modulus. The presets are generic screening values for typical products and must be replaced by the product datasheet in a design. A fluid can also be taken from a NeqSim thermodynamic system with fromNeqSim(String, SystemInterface, double, double).

    • fromNeqSim

      public static UmbilicalFluid fromNeqSim(String name, SystemInterface system, double temperatureK, double pressureBara)
      Take density, viscosity and bulk modulus of a liquid from a NeqSim thermodynamic system.

      The system is cloned, flashed at the given conditions (TP flash) and its properties are initialised. The bulk modulus follows from a second flash at a 20 bar higher pressure. The viscosity is taken at the given temperature and treated as temperature independent. A mixing rule must already be set on the system.

      Parameters:
      name - fluid name
      system - thermodynamic system with a mixing rule
      temperatureK - temperature in K
      pressureBara - pressure in bara
      Returns:
      fluid with NeqSim properties
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the system does not give a single liquid-like phase
